identificationModule.briefTitle: Candonilimab (AK104) Plus Preoperative Chemotherapy for Locally Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (ESCC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Candonilimab (AK104) Combined With Preoperative Chemotherapy in Patients With Locally Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (ESCC)

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, single-arm, open-label，multi-center, phase II study, aiming to evaluate the efficacy and safety of AK104 combined with preoperative chemotherapy in patients with locally advanced ESCC.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Eligible patients first receive AK104 (10mg/kg, iv, Q2W) for one cycle in the induction period, and then patients receive AK104 (10mg/kg, iv, Q3W) combined with nab-paclitaxel (130mg/m2 ivgtt d1，d8, Q3W) and carboplatin ((AUC=5) d1，Q3W) for 2 cycles. After neoadjuvant therapy of 3 cycles, patient will undergo preoperative evaluation. For patients who can be performed for R0 surgery, surgery wil be performed in 4 to 6 weeks. Patients who do not achieve Pathological complete response (pCR) will receive AK104 (10mg/kg, iv, Q3W) as adjuvant therapy until disease progression or intolerable toxicity for up to 12 months. Patients who achieve pCR after surgery will be enrolled in observational follow-up.

interventions.description: AK104 plus nab-paclitaxel and carboplatin as neoadjuvant therapy，and AK104 as adjuvant therapy for those who do not achieve pCR;
